timeline.summary: Ezrim offers Kaya leadership of the Zegana murder investigation.
timeline.quote: I would like you to assume leadership of this investigation.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya refuses Ezrim's offer and leaves.
timeline.quote: No. It's a complete sentence, and you know what it means.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya arrives at an Agency in uproar after the Azorius lost Etrata.
timeline.quote: The Agency headquarters were in chaos when Kaya arrived

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim rebukes his investigators over Etrata's disappearance.
timeline.quote: Etrata is still missing.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls Kellan from an argument and he explains Etrata vanished from Azorius custody.
timeline.quote: Detective Proft went to speak with the prisoner in Azorius custody. When he got there, she was gone.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim she now wants to lead the investigation.
timeline.quote: I would like to take point on this investigation.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim that Teysa Karlov has been murdered.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov has been murdered.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya explains she cannot summon Teysa's ghost, who has warded her own soul.
timeline.quote: Teysa will appear when she wants to.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim gives Kaya leadership of the investigation and tells her to begin with Judith.
timeline.quote: You returned before I could locate someone else to head the investigation. The position's yours.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim assigns Kellan to accompany Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inspector Kellan, you'll accompany her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya the evidence vault, including the containment capsule holding the Gruul god.
timeline.quote: That's where we're containing the Gruul god we detained

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya senses a ghost entering the building.
timeline.quote: A ghost just entered the building.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya his projektor and they review the evidence, doubting that Rakdos is behind the murders.
timeline.quote: I don't think Rakdos is behind this

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: An alarm announces that the evidence locker has been compromised.
timeline.quote: Someone's compromised the evidence locker!

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The evidence room lies in ruins as Anzrag breaks free.
timeline.quote: The room containing the evidence locker lay in ruins, the walls completely shattered by the force of whatever had been released.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Anzrag emerges from the dust and smashes an agent flat.
timeline.quote: the smoke parted as its occupant lunged forward, massive, spatulate front paws slamming into the floor.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.
timeline.quote: The Gruul call him Anzrag

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
timeline.quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
timeline.quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
timeline.quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through Anzrag's blow and traps him in the capsule.
timeline.quote: The capsule chimed, an incongruously pleasant sound, before expanding into a massive bubble, trapping Anzrag inside.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim orders agents to fetch Yarus, whom he blames for the breakout.
timeline.quote: Find Yarus and bring him back here. I know he had something to do with this.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos tells Kaya he must investigate alone, because it is too dangerous for a living person.
timeline.quote: this is too dangerous for a living person

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Delney delivers a note telling Kaya to meet at Karlov Cathedral alone.
timeline.quote: Meet at Karlov Cathedral. Come alone.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.
